summary:
Cracked iPad screen, a battery that drains too fast or a charging port that's stopped working? If you're in Bedfordview, help is close.

Our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte is about 13 km away, roughly a 16-minute drive. If you'd rather not deal with the traffic, we collect from your door for a flat R300 and bring your iPad back once it's fixed, insured both ways.

Every iPad repair starts with a free diagnostic, so you know the cost before any work begins. Repairs carry a 6-month warranty.

We look after iPhones, MacBooks, Apple Watches and iMacs for Bedfordview customers too.

Tap Learn more for Bedfordview collection details.
